infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Camera is required to visually detect mosquitoes and flies in your environment.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Microphone is used to detect the characteristic wing-beat frequency of mosquitoes (~400-600 Hz) and flies (~160-220 Hz).

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow MosquitoDetector to access your camera to detect insects.

plugins.microphonePermission: Allow MosquitoDetector to access your microphone to detect insect wing-beat frequencies.
